component.name: AnonPDF
component.summary: Edit PDFs without them leaving your computer

description.p: A PDF editor that does its work on your computer and nowhere else. No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no paid tier, and no network access: the sandbox gives it none, so it cannot upload your files.
Stack up as many changes as you like, watch the real output update as you go, and write a new file once at the end. The original is never modified.

ul.li: Rotate, reorder, delete, crop and resize pages
Add pages from other PDFs, then keep editing them like any other page
Fill, highlight, draw, add text, a watermark or page numbers
Merge, split, extract pages and compress
Turn pages into pictures, or pictures into a PDF
Pull out the text, sign a page, add or remove a password

description.p: Every change can be undone until you save. Files you open are copied into a private scratch folder that is deleted when the app closes.

screenshot.caption: The editor: see each change before you save

description.p: The first desktop release: the editor and every tool, in a window of its own.
